title: Coherent sheaves admit filtrations by ideal sheaves on integral closed subschemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must reduce arbitrary coherent sheaves, including nonreduced support, to rank-one ideal objects on integral closed subschemes. It combines minimal-support induction, splitting reducible support, ideal-power devissage and a generic-rank embedding with a smaller-support cokernel.
